metadata.name: 元
metadata.description: cell A1 of the origin spreadsheet. holds a formula/value that executes and renders in place; seeded with the readme. un-deletable (clearing restores the readme); editable.

cels.f: (dom "div.readme" (dom "h2" "the origin") (dom "p" "this is cell A1. put a formula or value here and it shows the result.") (dom "p" "  =1+1            shows 2") (dom "p" "  =grid(3, 3)     makes a 3x3 worksheet of cels like this one") (dom "p" "  =dom(\"h2\" \"hi\")  makes a heading") (dom "p" "click a cell label to edit it; clear A1 to bring this back."))

metadata.name: 元.mount
metadata.description: where the sheet view mounts. the host's one knob; null hides it.

metadata.name: 元.editing
metadata.description: key of the cell currently being edited (null = none).

metadata.name: 元.expanded
metadata.description: key of the cell whose formula is shown in the expanded panel (null = none).

metadata.name: 元.draft
metadata.description: the edit input's in-progress text.

metadata.name: 元.cells
metadata.description: ordered spreadsheet cell keys: 元 (A1) + genesis-created grid cels.

metadata.name: 元.view
metadata.description: the spreadsheet view. UNLOCKED — renders each cel as an editable cell; rework in place.

cels.f: (originView editing expanded draft mount keys vals)

metadata.name: originView
metadata.description: (editing expanded draft mount keys vals) - spreadsheet RenderSpec producer: 元 button + grid() layers as Excel tables + expanded formula panel.

metadata.name: dom
metadata.description: (tag ...children) - a presentation vnode value. tag.class emmet sugar; string children -> text, nested dom -> elements. Renders in the cell that holds it.

metadata.name: mount
metadata.description: (region content) - place a dom object in a named region the origin lays out around the sheet ("top", "bottom", ...), not in the cell that holds it. Deleting the formula removes it.

metadata.name: grid
metadata.description: (rows cols [name]) - genesis: an rows*cols worksheet of editable cels, each like 元. default sheet name g<r>x<c> so different shapes don't collide; same-shape needs a name. delete the formula -> swept.

metadata.name: sheets
metadata.description: (name1 r1 c1 name2 r2 c2 ...) - genesis: several named grids (a workbook) from one formula; delete the formula and all of them go.

metadata.name: origin.commit
metadata.description: (state, cellKey) - set the cell's content from the draft and re-evaluate; rebuild the cell list (new grids in, swept out); 元 un-deletable (empty restores readme).

metadata.name: origin.edit
metadata.description: (state, cellKey) - start editing a cell (seed draft with its source); click the active cell's label again to close.

metadata.name: origin.expand
metadata.description: (state, cellKey) - open/close the expanded formula panel for a cell (shares draft + commit with inline editing).

metadata.name: origin.key
metadata.description: (state, cellKey, event) - Enter commits the draft.

metadata.name: origin.effects
metadata.description: load/cels requests commit here (effects at drain).

metadata.name: origin.drain
metadata.description: (items) - execute load (ensureSegments) and cels (segment listing) requests; result text replaces the request as the cel's value.

metadata.name: load
metadata.description: (name) - load a library segment (lazy loaders + store).

metadata.name: cels
metadata.description: (segment) - readable listing of a segment's cels (skill first; locked marked).

metadata.name: inspect
metadata.description: (key) - the cel's full definition (celType, value, formula, metadata) as readable JSON.

metadata.name: segments
metadata.description: () - every loaded segment with role, version, dependencies.

metadata.name: vocab
metadata.description: (segment?) - the values + functions usable in formulas (callable lambdas/compilers + value cels) with descriptions; no arg = across all loaded segments.
